workspaces.label: Operations Hub
workspaces.primary_action: open the service that is reporting a problem
workspaces.empty_state: Every probe answered; no service is reporting a problem.
workspaces.why: Hub answers 'is anything wrong right now', so it is one scannable column of status cards with the service list inline; a split form would promise an input the room does not have.

workspaces.label: The Ledger
workspaces.primary_action: compare this period's consumption with the remaining balance
workspaces.empty_state: No credit read returned; the statement shows UNKNOWN rather than zero.

data_shown.name: provider, T2 model and cloud key state

workspaces.why: A ledger reconciles two columns - what was consumed against what remains - so the split shape puts period totals beside the line items they explain.

workspaces.label: Prospector
workspaces.primary_action: run a live scan and keep the rows above the ROI floor
workspaces.empty_state: Scanner returned no rows; show the cached-match fallback with its own source badge.

data_shown.name: ranked candidates (price, cost, net, ROI, score, sales/mo, buy box)

workspaces.why: Prospecting is filter-in and ranked-table-out, so one side holds the filter and the run control while the other holds the ranking it produced.

workspaces.label: Golden Goose
workspaces.primary_action: raise the deal-score floor until the list is short enough to act on
workspaces.empty_state: No deal clears the floor at this score; name the floor that would return one.

data_shown.name: qualified deals with net, ROI and score

workspaces.why: The room answers one question per item - is this deal worth a look - so the deals read as a ranked stream and a single score floor is the whole control surface.

workspaces.label: OfferChisel
workspaces.primary_action: generate title, bullets and keywords for the named product
workspaces.empty_state: No product named yet; the first step is the product name, not an empty result table.
workspaces.why: One deliverable is produced in a fixed order (name, style, generate, accept), so a wizard keeps the operator on the steps that actually exist.

workspaces.label: The Town Crier
workspaces.primary_action: write the caption for a brief and a platform
workspaces.empty_state: No brief typed; the composer opens on the brief, because a caption cannot exist before it.
workspaces.why: Caption generation is brief, platform, caption, reminder; a wizard shows that order and keeps the closed publish gate visible at the last step.

workspaces.label: The Auctioneer
workspaces.primary_action: compute break-even ACoS from the campaign numbers
workspaces.empty_state: No numbers entered; outputs stay blank, never zero.

data_shown.name: max CPC and ROI on invested cost

inputs_required: selling price, landed cost, referral, FBA, ad cost
workspaces.why: The page is arithmetic-in and break-even-out - eight entered campaign numbers on one side, the canonical verdict on the other - so every input stays visible next to the result it produced.

workspaces.label: AutothinK
workspaces.primary_action: run a prompt against the chosen model and keep the answer in history
workspaces.empty_state: No run yet; the composer is the only thing on the page until the first answer arrives.
workspaces.why: AutothinK is a run log with a composer, so the answer and every earlier answer belong in one vertical stream rather than in a dashboard of tiles.

workspaces.label: The Watch
workspaces.primary_action: read the watchlist for signals
workspaces.empty_state: Scanner unread; the watchlist says so instead of showing an empty list.

data_shown.name: watchlist rows (price, ROI, buy box, status)
tracked count, signal count, average price

workspaces.why: A watchlist is a short stream of things to glance at - one line per product with its signal state - not a form and not a board.

workspaces.label: RankLedger
workspaces.primary_action: read which band a product's score places it in
workspaces.empty_state: No scored rows; the board shows empty bands rather than a fabricated ranking.

data_shown.name: ranked table with ROI, sales/mo and score
tracked count, strong count, average ROI

workspaces.why: The row's job is its standing, so three score bands read as board columns (strong, competitive, weak) and a product's position carries the message.

workspaces.label: The Rival Board
workspaces.primary_action: read which products sit in the price-saturated lane
workspaces.empty_state: No posture rows; the lanes stay empty and labelled.

data_shown.name: posture table (price, ROI, buy box, posture)

workspaces.why: Risk is a lane, not a number: grouping each product into high-margin, benign or price-saturated makes the saturated lane the thing the eye lands on.

workspaces.label: Account
workspaces.primary_action: read what the plan allows
workspaces.empty_state: Entitlements unreadable; show the failure instead of a default plan.
workspaces.why: Account is a short statement of permissions and usage, so it reads as a vertical list of what this org may run rather than a settings form.

workspaces.label: Operations Hub
workspaces.primary_action: read the failing subsystem and its evidence
workspaces.empty_state: Foundation unreachable; every section says UNKNOWN with the reason.

data_shown.name: queue / schedule posture and audit tail

workspaces.why: Foundation health is many independent probes - providers, marketplaces, approvals, audit - so one column of probe cards, each with its own state, beats a grid that implies the numbers are comparable.

workspaces.label: Jobs & Schedules
workspaces.primary_action: create a durable job or flip a schedule
workspaces.empty_state: No durable jobs; the board starts empty with the create form attached, because the first job is the operator's own.
workspaces.why: A job has a state and a state is a column; the create form belongs beside the board because every job is born from it.

workspaces.label: Keywords & SEO
workspaces.primary_action: search the store, then submit an import
workspaces.empty_state: No keyword-store match; the panel says the store is empty rather than showing zero coverage.
workspaces.why: Keyword work is find-then-import, so search and its results stay on one side while the import batch and its rejected rows stay on the other.

workspaces.label: Onboarding & Plan
workspaces.primary_action: accept the invitation or sign in
workspaces.empty_state: The landing is always the first step; there is no empty variant.
workspaces.why: A landing page has one job - send the visitor to accept or sign in - so it is a two-step gate rather than a dashboard of programme detail.

workspaces.label: Support
workspaces.primary_action: read who handles beta support
workspaces.empty_state: The section renders only when the #support hash is present; otherwise the landing stands alone.
workspaces.why: Support here is two sentences and a pointer to the ticket queue, so a single short card is the honest shape and anything larger would be padding.

workspaces.label: Invite entry
workspaces.primary_action: submit the invite code and email
workspaces.empty_state: No code yet; the form waits rather than pre-filling a guess.
workspaces.why: Redemption is one form and one result, so the wizard is a single step whose only required evidence is the code.

workspaces.label: Tester Dashboard
workspaces.primary_action: open the organisation that needs attention
workspaces.empty_state: No organisations in the cohort; the board stays empty rather than showing sample rows.
workspaces.why: An organisation moves through lifecycle states, so a board keyed by state shows the cohort's shape at a glance and the drill-down is one click from the column.

workspaces.label: Design Studio
workspaces.primary_action: upload a source asset, then compose the surface it belongs to
workspaces.empty_state: No project open; the canvas offers a surface picker before an empty sheet.
workspaces.why: The studio's output is a picture or a dieline, so the workspace is the canvas itself; picking a surface replaces the form instead of sitting beside it.

workspaces.label: SourceScout
workspaces.primary_action: stage an ASIN and read the gates it still owes
workspaces.empty_state: No ASIN staged; the evidence panels stay empty and the gates stay UNKNOWN.

data_shown.name: ASIN rows with UNKNOWN fields until read

workspaces.why: Research is ASIN-in and evidence-out, so the ASIN field owns the left side while every unread gate stays UNKNOWN on the right instead of being filled with a guess.

workspaces.label: Golden Goose
workspaces.primary_action: evaluate the candidate against the gates
workspaces.empty_state: No candidate; the gate list is visible but the verdict stays blank.
workspaces.why: A verdict only means something next to the gates that produced it, so gates sit left and the checklist plus verified commission sit right.

workspaces.label: Listing Guardian
workspaces.primary_action: read the highest-severity alert
workspaces.empty_state: No local listing records; the board says the source is empty, not that listings are healthy.
workspaces.why: Alerts already carry a severity, so severity is the column and review is a movement; a board shows both without inventing a control the service lacks.

workspaces.label: Keyword Tracker
workspaces.primary_action: read coverage for one keyword
workspaces.empty_state: No keyword rows; the feed says the store is empty.
workspaces.why: Tracking is a per-keyword read with a coverage badge, so each keyword is one row in a stream that can be scanned for movement.

workspaces.label: Competitor Monitor
workspaces.primary_action: read the cached observation and its quantity match
workspaces.empty_state: No observations; the panel labels the catalog cached instead of implying live tracking.
workspaces.why: Observations are independent snapshots, so they stack as labelled rows rather than pretending to be a live competitor grid.

workspaces.label: ListingForge
workspaces.primary_action: draft, edit, then save the listing record
workspaces.empty_state: No brief; the wizard starts at the product name.
workspaces.why: Composition is brief, proposal, edit, saved record, and the save is a distinct step, so a wizard makes the persistence boundary visible.

workspaces.label: AdPilot
workspaces.primary_action: read the imported campaign and request ad copy
workspaces.empty_state: No imported file; campaigns show UNKNOWN and the copy panel waits.

data_shown.name: campaign rows with spend and ACoS

inputs_required: product name, brand tone, format hint
workspaces.why: Ad work is evidence-in (the seller's own file) and proposal-out, so split keeps the imported metrics beside the copy they justify.

workspaces.label: SocialPulse
workspaces.primary_action: move a draft to review, then to publish-ready
workspaces.empty_state: No drafts; the columns stay empty and the composer is the only way in.
workspaces.why: The room is a content pipeline, so drafts, review, approval and publish-ready are columns and the value is where each post sits.

workspaces.label: Profitability
workspaces.primary_action: compute contribution and readiness from the unit inputs
workspaces.empty_state: No inputs; the result panel stays blank and readiness stays UNKNOWN.
workspaces.why: Unit economics is inputs-in and verdict-out with a readiness gate, so the numbers stay on one side and the canonical result with its gate pill on the other.

bojo_tool.note: A non-core service opens no tool of its own; the frame stays off and the room keeps its page.

default_workspace.why: The fallback for every service that is not one of the core six: the home scene and no workspace frame, because the file only describes a workspace it can actually argue for.

bojo_tool.note: chat_tools.TOOLS['generate_image'] renders one image locally and refuses to paint text, logos or barcodes.

scene_workspaces.why: Twelve sections of one creative job share a single canvas and one design document, so the workspace keeps them behind a section picker instead of pretending they are twelve separate rooms.

scene_workspaces.label: Listing Guardian

bojo_tool.note: chat_tools.TOOLS['optimize_listing'] rewrites a listing from supplied facts.

scene_workspaces.why: A watchtower is read-first: alerts, then the diffs behind them, then what was done, then what was handed to a human - the tab order is the triage order.

scene_workspaces.label: AdPilot

bojo_tool.note: chat_tools.TOOLS['plan_campaign'] proposes a campaign from supplied facts; it never pushes to an ad platform.

scene_workspaces.why: PPC work is a loop - read the campaigns, open one, mine the search terms, harvest the winners, then plan the next pass - so the tabs are that loop in order, with detail as a tab rather than a modal.

scene_workspaces.label: Golden Goose

bojo_tool.note: chat_tools.TOOLS['golden_goose_scan'] scores candidates and returns the arithmetic; the tool's also_used_by names golden-goose.

scene_workspaces.why: A sourcing queue only earns a screen if review, decision and history sit beside it - the queue is worthless without the trail of what was decided and why.

scene_workspaces.label: SourceScout

bojo_tool.note: chat_tools.TOOLS['scan_products'] runs the local scanner; every row it returns carries its own source badge.

scene_workspaces.why: Product research moves one product at a time from a lookup, into a set, into a saved set with a coverage statement, so the four tabs are the four states a candidate can be in.

scene_workspaces.label: Product Pictures

bojo_tool.note: No product_picture tool is wired in chat_tools yet, so this surface opens the shared generate_image lane rather than claiming a tool it does not have.

scene_workspaces.why: One job - the main image and its secondary modules for a single listing - so it gets one view and no tab strip: the format, slot and compliance rails already live inside the surface.
